_doc: KNOWN, REVIEWED schema-drift exceptions consumed by scripts/schema-drift-check.mjs (--ignore). Every entry is an explicit, reviewed decision — never a silent skip. Keep this list MINIMAL: a permanent exception reported on every run is how a check gets tuned out (which is how drift ran unnoticed for weeks). Green-when-clean, loud-when-new. REMOVE an entry the moment the divergence is converged. Prior 'unknown prod-orphan' deferrals (sites.custom_domain*, site_annotations.*) were resolved and removed 2026-07-18 (custom_domain converged via 20260718120000_c2_convergence_round2; site_annotations is fully defined in 00000000000000_baseline_schema.sql).

_rationale.sites.owner_id: DELIBERATE founder decision — NOT drift-by-neglect. prod's sites.owner_id has DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(); staging has no default. Intentionally left divergent for now (reconciling the default is a separate planned change, not part of C2 convergence). REMOVE this entry once the default is converged across environments so the check re-enforces the column. Documented in PR #291 and KNOWN_ISSUES.
